messages:
anna-cs: quick heads up — client AcmeCorp escalated: rerank endpoint returning negative, non-normalized scores and intermittently 400s when batch_size > 32. Theyre confused because they expected probabilities.

anna-cs: repro steps they sent: curl to /v1/rerank with payload of ~40 candidates, no extra params. example payload below.

anna-cs: ```
{
  \"query\": \"how to reset password\",
  \"candidates\": [\"reset steps\", \"forgot password flow\", \"account recovery\", /* ~40 items */],
  \"model\": \"rerank-v1\",\n  \"batch_size\": 40
}
```

ben-eng: thanks. first: 400s for batch_size > 32 sounds like request-size limit or validation error. Can you paste exact 400 body?

anna-cs: they attached this: `{\"error\":\"Bad Request: candidate list too large\"}` — but sometimes it succeeds and returns values like `[-3.2, -0.1, 0.5, -10.0]` for scores.

carla-ml: fyi the reranker returns raw logits by default (not probabilities). Negative numbers are normal for logits — you need softmax to convert to a distribution. Also if they batch multiple queries in one call the scores are not normalized across queries.

anna-cs: thanks. client insists product docs say \"score: higher is better (0..1)\" — that mismatch is on us.

ben-eng: two action items: 1) immediate customer-facing guidance = explain logits vs probs + provide reproducible softmax snippet. 2) engineer follow-up to tighten API error message for oversized candidate lists. @carla-ml can you drop the snippet?

carla-ml: sure — quick softmax (stable):
```python
import math
def stable_softmax(scores):
    m = max(scores)
    exps = [math.exp(s - m) for s in scores]
    s = sum(exps)
    return [e / s for e in exps]
# apply per-query candidate set
```

carla-ml: note: if they expect per-candidate probability across multiple queries in the same batch they must softmax each group's scores separately. Also rounding may make very small probabilities look like 0.

jason-support: adding the customer note: they tried normalizing across the entire payload (all queries concatenated) which caused wrong ranking. Clarified this to them.

leo-sre: about the 400: our API currently caps candidates_per_request = 32 for rerank-v1. We should return a more actionable error: \"candidate list exceeds 32, split into multiple requests or use streaming\". I'll add a small change to validation.

anna-cs: client also reported intermittent 401 earlier in same session, turned out to be expired API key. Mentioning because they thought 401 correlated with weird scores. Separate issues but flagged.

ben-eng: good call. Summarizing recommended support reply: 1) explain logits vs probabilities + softmax snippet; 2) explain per-query normalization; 3) call out request-size cap (32) and show how to chunk; 4) verify API key validity for 401s; 5) offer a repro run with our team (we can run their exact payload privately).

anna-cs: sending that to client now. Also asking if they want us to run repro. :thumbsup:

carla-ml: one more note — we should update public docs to say \"rerank returns raw scores (logits). Use softmax to convert to probabilities.\" and add example code. Filing doc ticket.

leo-sre: deployed clearer 400 message to staging, will push to prod after quick smoke.

infra-bot: Deploy started by leo-sre at 2026-03-17T15:22:00Z — validation rule updated for rerank request size.

ben-eng: thanks everyone. @anna-cs please paste customer reply here when available and mark if they want eng-run.

anna-cs: replied with example of their normalization errors and they asked for us to run their full 40-candidate payload. I told them we can run if they split into two requests or we can run internally and attach results. They accepted internal run.

ben-eng: I'll run internal repro against rerank-v1 with their payload split and attach logs. Will report back with raw logits + softmax table and recommended docs text.

anna-cs: resolved for now, thanks team :tada:
